message.content:
Below is a quick‑look “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
A long weekend is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a **Friday** or a **Monday** (or is observed on a Monday when it falls on a weekend).  When a holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday it is usually observed on the following Monday, which also creates a 3‑day weekend.

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Notes / Province(s) |
|------|---------|-------------|---------------------|
| **Jan 1** (Sun) | New Year’s Day | Sun | Observed Mon 2 |
| **Jan 2** (Mon) | New Year’s Day (observed) | Mon | 3‑day weekend (Sun‑Mon) |
| **Feb 20** (Mon) | Family Day | Mon | Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island |
| **Apr 7** (Fri) | Good Friday | Fri | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sun) |
| **May 22** (Mon) | Victoria Day | Mon | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon) |
| **Jul 1** (Sat) | Canada Day | Sat | Observed Mon 3 |
| **Jul 3** (Mon) | Canada Day (observed) | Mon | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon) |
| **Sep 4** (Mon) | Labour Day | Mon | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon) |
| **Oct 9** (Mon) | Thanksgiving | Mon | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon) |
| **Nov 11** (Sat) | Remembrance Day | Sat | Observed Mon 13 |
| **Nov 13** (Mon) | Remembrance Day (observed) | Mon | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon) |
| **Dec 25** (Mon) | Christmas Day | Mon | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon) |
| **Dec 26** (Tue) | Boxing Day | Tue | (No long weekend unless you take Dec 27 off) |

### Quick Summary

| Long‑Weekend | Dates (2023) | Province(s) |
|--------------|--------------|-------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1–2 | All provinces |
| Family Day | Feb 20 | AB, BC, ON, SK, NB, PEI |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | All provinces |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | All provinces |
| Canada Day | Jul 1–3 | All provinces |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | All provinces |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | All provinces |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11–13 | All provinces |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | All provinces |

> **Tip for your holiday‑planning app:**  
> - If you want to offer “extended” long weekends (e.g., taking the day before/after a holiday), you can flag the adjacent weekdays (e.g., Mon 2 for New Year’s, Mon 20 for Family Day, etc.).  
> - Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island). If you need those, let me know and I can add them.

Feel free to copy this table into your app’s calendar module or let me know if you’d like it in a different format (JSON, CSV, etc.).
